description: Optional 25 Ma requested-age motion windows copied byte-for-byte from the verified all-age Cao palette; the full palette remains authoritative and loads in the background.

derivation.method: For each canonical 25 Ma window, select every palette entry reachable through a lifecycle-overlapping core or material-correction chart binding. Copy all original records inside the window and the immediate younger and older bracketing records when available. Preserve touching binding entries at closed endpoints.
derivation.recordSemantics: Every EHMT record is an exact byte slice of motion-palette.bin. Tiles add no rotation, interpolation, reconstruction, palaeogeographic, or surface evidence.
derivation.sourceRecordIndices: Each tile descriptor hashes the ordered little-endian uint32 indices of its records in the full palette binary.

source.title: Cao et al. 2024 global plate model v2.4, EarthHistory verified compiled motion palette
source.geographicBasis: Cao v2.4 palaeomagnetic frame with anchor plate 0 and the package-pinned rotation/topology identities
source.evidenceRole: transport partition of the existing verified motion controls only

limitations: A tile is valid only with the exact bound core, correction catalog, motion catalog, full binary identity, package revision, and frame.
The eight unreferenced legacy palette entries need not appear because the full palette remains the background authority.
Explicit source-seam gaps remain unsupported; tiles must not interpolate across them.
The static geometry, material evidence, country references, chart IDs, picking IDs, and scientific support state are unchanged.
